description: Today's predicted high and low tide times (KST), heights, KMA wave/wind forecast, latest observed water temperature and the KHOA fishing index at 14 South Korean ports, measured beach waves at 10 beaches, KHOA surfing and scuba indexes (swimming and rip-current indexes in summer), plus current KMA marine and wind warnings (Incheon, Ansan, Boryeong, Gunsan, Mokpo, Wando, Yeosu, Tongyeong, Busan, Ulsan, Mukho, Sokcho, Jeju, Seogwipo) from the Korea Hydrographic and Oceanographic Agency, with tidal range and the Korean tide-day count (mulddae, e.g. 3물, 조금) from the lunar date. Heights are not comparable between ports. Check is_past (refreshed around 05:00 KST). Without port: all 14.
